assets.subject: puzzles
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone transparent PNG icon for a Weekend TV onboarding style comparison.
Primary request: Create one polished original square icon.
Scene/backdrop: A genuinely transparent background with alpha, isolated object cutout. This will sit above white text on a deep blue or green game-show stage, but do not draw any stage or background.
Subject: A weekly calendar with a prominent, instantly recognizable interlocking jigsaw-puzzle-piece motif on its face and one small freshness sparkle. The calendar has two simple binding loops and abstract day grid marks with no letters or numbers. It conveys fresh puzzles every week.
Style/medium: Playful rounded tactile soft 3D, buttery yellow forms, small violet accents, soft studio highlights. A cohesive friendly toy-like object with controlled detail and velvety, gently rounded material.
Composition/framing: Centered large unified silhouette, square 1:1 canvas. Entire object and all accents fit within the central 76% of the image, leaving generous transparent margins of roughly 12% on every side. Use a consistent visual subject scale, legible at 128–180 pixels. Gently dynamic three-quarter view for 3D subjects, clear near-frontal graphic composition for illustration. Keep all accents compact.
Color palette: Brand yellow #ffda0a is dominant, with dark navy for structure and violet/cyan accents where appropriate to the stated style.
Constraints: One standalone icon only, high craft, clean edges, controlled detail, coherent compact composition. Preserve actual alpha transparency. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, hands, people, stage, background rectangle, checkerboard pattern, ground plane, or detached cast shadow.
